minor.issue: Returns 502 'Payments are temporarily unavailable' for all Confirmed quotes because STRIPE_API_KEY currently stored is a Stripe publishable key (pk_...) not a secret key (sk_...). Expected per review-request context; not a code bug. Replacing with sk_test_* or sk_live_* will unblock Checkout session creation.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _mark_paid_if_complete validates s.metadata.quote_id against str(doc['_id']); make sure Stripe session creation at line ~588 passes str(doc['_id']) (it does). Good.

server.py /api/payments/checkout returns 502 for any StripeError including auth errors. Consider distinguishing stripe.error.AuthenticationError into a 500 with a clearer server-side log so ops can see a key-misconfiguration vs. transient Stripe outage. Minor.
server.py JWT TTL is 30 days without refresh/rotation. Fine for this app class but consider revocation (e.g. keep a user.token_version claim) if an account is ever compromised.
login.tsx access-code-input uses keyboardType='number-pad' which is correct for the 7-digit code; good. Consider adding a maxLength={7} for additional guard-rail.

server.py _code_ok uses hmac.compare_digest -- good constant-time comparison.
